title: EG Group - potential acquisition of Caltex Australia Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.

Timeline suspended pending receipt of further information. Former provisional date for announcement of findings (11 June 2020) is delayed. The ACCC will announce a new provisional decision date in due course.
The ACCC decided it would discontinue its investigation into the proposed acquisition. The review may be recommenced subsequently.

body_sections.Summary: EG Group submitted a proposal to acquire Caltex Australia Limited.
